category: exploratory synthetic engineering and identifiability recovery

previous_experiment.root_cause: PyG Data.to() mutated the original graph; permutation indexed CUDA edges with CPU inverse indices

hypothesis: One stable reified node per unique ordered FK mapping, with duplicate declaration multiplicity metadata, exposes separate stable G-reasoner scores and may yield a synthetic query-conditioned signal beyond dense cosine.
code_change: move_graph() clones the PyG Data object before calling Data.to(device); experiment ID and all artifact paths are new

success_criteria.mapping_identity: 3 declarations derive 2 stable IDs by SHA-256 of the ordered source/target table/column tuple with multiplicities 2/1; reverse declaration order preserves IDs/counts
success_criteria.model_output: direct graph [1,2], reified graph [1,4], all finite
success_criteria.permutation: mapping-only max absolute score delta <= 1e-5 and same mapping top-1 set after stable-ID remap
success_criteria.synthetic_signal: GFM top-1 correct on at least 3/4 queries, strictly more than dense cosine, and positive mean score margins for both billing and shipping groups
success_criteria.overall_status: G0_SYNTHETIC_PASS only if every registered gate passes; execution failure is IMPLEMENTATION_FAILURE; no post-result threshold changes
